high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously contrasts two Japanese kanji characters with their meanings. The top part of the image shows two kanji characters: On the left, the kanji "女" (onna) is labeled as "Women" in Japanese. On the right, the kanji "姦" (kana) is labeled as "Noisy" in Japanese. Below these kanji characters, there is a scene from a TV show featuring two men sitting at a bar. The man on the left has short blonde hair and is wearing a dark suit with a blue shirt and tie.
